meta.name: The Last Frontier
meta.description: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.

videos.title: Blue Skies
videos.overview: An unprecedented emergency sends Fairbanks into lockdown. Frank gathers every resource available to mount a full-scale response.

videos.title: Wind of Change
videos.overview: Luke tries to get back home as the manhunt for Havlock intensifies. Frank weighs whether he should give in to a set of demands.

videos.title: Country as F**k
videos.overview: Sarah's disappearance adds urgency to Frank's search. Havlock's master plan takes an unexpected turn, increasing the number of hostages.

videos.title: American Dream
videos.overview: A state trooper goes missing, widening Frank's investigation. Armed locals join the manhunt. Sarah grows concerned over Luke's whereabouts.

videos.title: Arnaq
videos.overview: Frank focuses on tracking down Luke. The CIA's involvement ramps up as Havlock's plan enters a new phase.

videos.title: The Devil Wears a Suit and Tie
videos.overview: Fairbanks is hit with a mass power outage. Sarah spots someone suspicious in the ER. Sidney tries to get control of a key piece of evidence.

videos.title: Change of Time
videos.overview: A mysterious new suspect is interrogated. Frank's secret comes to light. Havlock works on retrieving the contents of his hard drive.

videos.title: L'air Perdu
videos.overview: Sidney learns about her father's past, the Atwater Protocol, and the classified intel in Archive 6.

videos.title: Converge
videos.overview: Bradford lands in Fairbanks with a CIA task force and new primary target. Sidney makes a desperate attempt to expose the truth.

videos.title: Everything Trying
videos.overview: Sidney and Havlock risk it all to gain possession of the archive. Frank sets out on a life-saving mission.
